risks.title: BOEM financial assurance regulations
risks.score_rationale: This risk ranks highest among risk factors, with strong language (significantly increases) and direct impact on cash flow and operational capacity. Partial implementation and ongoing legal challenges increase regulatory uncertainty. The Regulation category is highly weighted here.

risks.title: Shortage of bonding capacity
risks.score_rationale: The text highlights a material reduction (materially reduced) in access to surety bonds due to sector bankruptcies. This directly affects the ability to complete acquisitions or partnerships. The risk is amplified by macroeconomic conditions and the Capital category is critical.

risks.title: Deepwater operations are inherently risky
risks.score_rationale: The risk is cited with a notable example (Deepwater Horizon) and mentions losses that could exceed insurance coverage and threaten viability. Alarming language (going concern issues), central placement in the document.

risks.title: Vulnerability to storms and currents
risks.score_rationale: The risk is recurring (periodic) and specifically tied to the Gulf of America geography. It impacts production and costs. Although predictable, its intensity (repairs, evacuations) justifies high severity. The Geopolitical category includes regional climate risks.

risks.title: Instability of offshore drilling policies
risks.score_rationale: The document describes major political reversals (Biden vs Trump), legal challenges, and uncertain drilling programs. The risk is existential for future permit access. Strong language (material adverse effect), detailed presentation.

risks.title: Contested biological opinion under litigation
risks.score_rationale: The 2025 opinion was ruled illegal and remanded but remains in effect. Two lawsuits are ongoing. This creates major regulatory uncertainty for operations. While not existential, it could potentially halt activities.

risks.title: Commodity price volatility
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned multiple times with historical volatility data. Although partially hedged through derivatives, it remains a major source of revenue instability. Prominent placement in the revenue section.
